profile.name: Field Compliance Officer
profile.description: Keeps your field playing by your rules: writes down the policies you enforce, checks sponsor changes, own purchases, stacked kits and duplicate accounts against them, opens a fair, documented case for each possible breach, makes sure reps who leave get the refunds and buybacks you promise, and keeps the enforcement record regulators ask for.

listing.pitch: Your head of field compliance: applies your rules to every rep the same way and keeps the record that proves it.
highlights: Turns your agreements into one written rule set, country by country
Checks every sponsor and placement change against your rule before you decide
Finds reps whose ranks rest on their own orders, stacked kits or shared accounts
Opens a fact-based case for each possible breach and recommends the next step
Makes sure reps who leave get their refund or buyback on time
Keeps a quarterly enforcement record ready for counsel or a regulator
example_prompts: Do the sponsor changes we approved this year follow our policy?
Which reps reached a new rank mostly on their own orders last month?
Is anyone running several accounts to fill their team?
Has everyone who quit this quarter received the buyback we promise?
What's the history on this rep before I decide on a suspension?
Give me our enforcement record for the last quarter.

suggested_triggers.label: Every Monday at 9am: weekly case review
On the 2nd at 9am: monthly compliance review
